newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bank sells 75 mln pesos mortgage bonds. [CORRECTED 23:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Argentine bank sells 75 mln pesos mortgage bonds. [CORRECTED 23:40 GMT]

text.p: Argentine mortgage bank Banco Hipotecario Nacional has issued 75 million pesos of mortgage-backed bonds, lead underwriter Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said Tuesday.

The bonds, which mature in 13 years, carry a coupon of 8.5 percent (corrects from 9.5 percent) and are the first bonds of their kind to be issued in pesos. Interest payments and amortizations will be made monthly.
There is a yearly option to sell the bonds at the cut-off yield, which was 9.5 percent (corrects from 9.94 percent).
Banco Hipotecario initially offered 50 million pesos but because offers received came to 214 million pesos, the amount of the issue was increased to 75 million pesos.
Deutsche said there was a wide variety of interest in the bonds from banks, investment funds, pension funds, insurance companies and private investors.

The issue is part of Hipotecarios' recently launched 100 million peso program of mortgage-backed bonds. Tuesday's issue is the senior tranche, while another 9.5 million is expected to be issued as subordinated debt while the remainder will be participation certificates.
